title: Cash Control Settings
description: Tenant-wide policy for drawer closes, variance handling, cash-change rounding, and drawer custody. POS session settings are under POS Settings.
varianceOrderHint: Tolerance must be at or below the reason threshold, which must be at or below the approval threshold.
viewOnlyDescription: You can view these settings but don't have permission to change them.
customerWarningTitle: This takes money from the customer
customerWarning: Rounding change down on every cash sale reduces what the customer receives. Some jurisdictions restrict this — make sure it fits your local rules before saving.

blindCloseEnabled.label: Blind close
blindCloseEnabled.description: Hide the expected-cash figure from the cashier until the physical count is submitted.

varianceGateMode.label: Variance gate
varianceGateMode.description: What happens when a drawer close doesn't match the expected cash amount.

varianceToleranceAmount.label: Auto-accept below
varianceToleranceAmount.description: Variance below this amount is accepted silently.

varianceReasonAmount.label: Reason required above
varianceReasonAmount.description: At or above this amount, the cashier must give a reason.

varianceThresholdAmount.label: Approval required above
varianceThresholdAmount.description: At or above this amount, a supervisor must approve the close.

cashTrackingMode.label: Checkout cash tracking
cashTrackingMode.description: Whether cash tenders at checkout capture denomination detail.

openingCountMode.label: Opening count
openingCountMode.description: Denomination detail required when opening a drawer.

closingCountMode.label: Closing count
closingCountMode.description: Denomination detail required when closing a drawer.

cashChangeBearer.label: Who absorbs change rounding
cashChangeBearer.description: When change can't be given to the exact fils/cent, who keeps or loses the difference.

cashChangeRoundToMinor.label: Round change to nearest (minor units)
cashChangeRoundToMinor.description: Leave blank to use the currency's own rounding rule.

drawerAssignmentMode.label: Drawer assignment
drawerAssignmentMode.description: Whether any cashier can use a drawer, or only the assigned one.

sharedSessionMode.label: Shared sessions
sharedSessionMode.description: Whether more than one POS session can run against the same open drawer.

maxCashEnforceMode.label: Max cash enforcement
maxCashEnforceMode.description: What happens when a drawer's cash balance exceeds its configured limit.

cashDropRequiresDest.label: Cash drops require a destination
cashDropRequiresDest.description: Forbid a cash transfer out of a drawer with no safe, bank, or drawer named as the destination.

posSessionModeOrderEntry.label: POS session — order entry
posSessionModeOrderEntry.description: Creating or updating an order with a payment. Cash always also needs an open cash drawer session.

posSessionModeLaterColl.label: POS session — later payment collection
posSessionModeLaterColl.description: Collecting a payment on an existing order after it was created.

posSessionModeStoredVal.label: POS session — wallet, advance and gift-card sales
posSessionModeStoredVal.description: Wallet top-ups, customer advances and gift-card sales that take payment.

posSessionModeCustRcpt.label: POS session — customer account receipts
posSessionModeCustRcpt.description: Receiving a payment on a customer's account (Customers → receive payment).

posSessionModeManualVchr.label: POS session — manual finance vouchers
posSessionModeManualVchr.description: Posting a voucher by hand from Finance → Vouchers when it carries a payment.

posSessionModeCashRefd.label: POS session — cash refunds
posSessionModeCashRefd.description: Processing a refund paid out in cash. The cash drawer session is required either way.

posSessionRolloverMode.label: Business-date rollover
posSessionRolloverMode.description: What happens to a still-open POS session when the business day rolls over.

posSessionStaleHours.label: Stale session alert (hours)
posSessionStaleHours.description: Flag a POS session as stale after it has been open this many hours.

shiftZReportRequired.label: Z-report required at close
shiftZReportRequired.description: Require a Z-report to be generated as part of closing the POS session.

requiresSession.label: Requires an open session
requiresSession.description: Cash can only be taken on this drawer while a session is open.

openingCountRequired.label: Opening count required
openingCountRequired.description: A physical count must be entered when a session opens.

closingCountRequired.label: Closing count required
closingCountRequired.description: A physical count must be entered when a session closes.

varianceGateMode.WARN_ONLY: Warn only — flag it, allow the close

posSessionRequirementMode.OPTIONAL: Optional — linked when one is open

changeBearerExample.BUSINESS: Example: change owed is 9.997 {currency}, rounded up to 10.000 {currency} — the business absorbs the extra 0.003.
changeBearerExample.CUSTOMER: Example: change owed is 9.997 {currency}, rounded down to 9.990 {currency} — the customer loses 0.007.
changeBearerExample.NEAREST: Example: change owed is 9.997 {currency}, rounded to the nearest step — usually 10.000 {currency}.

messages.loadFailed: Failed to load cash control settings.
messages.saveFailed: Failed to save cash control settings.
